title: Refund Policy
intro: At KokoFresh, customer satisfaction is our priority. This Refund Policy outlines the conditions and processes for requesting refunds, ensuring fairness and transparency.

sections.heading: 1. Eligibility for Refunds
sections.body:
Refunds will be considered under the following circumstances:

  • Damaged or Defective Products: If the product delivered is damaged, defective, or does not match the description provided on the platform.
  • Missing Items: If an order is incomplete or items are missing.
  • Delivery Delays: If the product is not delivered within the specified timeframe due to reasons within the seller’s control.

sections.heading: 2. Non-Refundable Situations
sections.body:
Refunds will not be issued under these conditions:

  • Products that have been consumed, tampered with, or improperly stored after delivery.
  • Delays caused by factors beyond KokoFresh’s or the seller’s control (e.g. weather, strikes, or natural disasters).
  • Change of mind after the order has been delivered.

sections.heading: 3. Timeframe for Requesting Refunds
sections.body: Refund requests must be submitted within 24 hours of receiving the order. Requests submitted beyond this timeframe will not be eligible for a refund.

sections.heading: 4. Process for Requesting Refunds
sections.body:
To request a refund, follow these steps:

  1. Contact Us: Email help@kokofresh.in or call +91 78927 76610 within 24 hours of receiving the order.
  2. Provide Evidence: Submit clear photographs or videos of the product showing the damage, defect, or issue. Include order details (order ID, date, and item name).
  3. Review: Once your request is received, our team will review it in consultation with the seller and respond within 3–5 business days.

sections.heading: 5. Refund Resolution Options
sections.body:
If your refund request is approved, you may choose one of the following:

  • Replacement: The seller will resend the product at no additional cost.
  • Refund to Original Payment Method: The amount will be credited back to the payment method used at the time of purchase. This process may take 7–10 business days, depending on your bank.
  • Store Credit: You may opt to receive the refund as store credit, which can be used for future purchases on KokoFresh.

sections.heading: 6. Conditions for Refunds
sections.body:
• Refunds will only be processed after verifying the issue.
  • KokoFresh reserves the right to reject refund requests if sufficient proof is not provided or if the claim is found to be invalid.

sections.heading: 7. Cancellations
sections.body:
• Orders can be canceled before they are shipped. Once shipped, the order is no longer eligible for cancellation.
  • Cancellations may be subject to a restocking fee, depending on the seller’s policy.

sections.heading: 8. Disputes
sections.body:
• In the event of disputes regarding refunds, KokoFresh will mediate between the buyer and seller to reach a resolution.
  • Final decisions will be made by KokoFresh based on the evidence provided.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to the Refund Policy
sections.body:
KokoFresh reserves the right to modify this Refund Policy at any time. Changes will be communicated via email or platform notifications.

Continued use of the platform after changes implies acceptance of the updated Refund Policy.

sections.heading: 10. Contact Us
sections.body:
For any refund-related inquiries, please reach out to us:

  • Email: help@kokofresh.in
  • Phone: +91 78927 76610

closing.heading: Your Satisfaction Matters
closing.body: By using KokoFresh, you agree to this Refund Policy. We are committed to providing a delightful experience and addressing your concerns promptly and fairly.
